definitions.explanation: a severe or life-threatening illness or medical condition

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{重病|じゅうびょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
{重病|じゅうびょう}⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{集中治療室|しゅうちゅうちりょうしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れられた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: The critically ill patient was placed in the intensive care unit.

examples.japanese: {重病|じゅうびょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{克服|こくふく}して→克服する：15863_kokufukusuru⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}{復帰|ふっき}→社会復帰：20417_shakaifukki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たした→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感動|かんどう}した→感動する：21603_kandousuru⟧。
examples.english: I was moved by the sight of her overcoming a serious illness and returning to society.

notes:
Composed of {重|じゅう} (heavy, serious) + {病|びょう} (illness). Describes a condition that is severe enough to be life-threatening or to require intensive medical care.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {重病|じゅうびょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧: to fall seriously ill
- {重病|じゅうびょう}⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧: critically ill patient
- {重病|じゅうびょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{患|わずら}う→患う：27883_wazurau⟧: to suffer from a serious illness
- {重病|じゅうびょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{克服|こくふく}する→克服する：15863_kokufukusuru⟧: to overcome a serious illness
- {重病|じゅうびょう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{回復|かいふく}する→回復する：21330_kaifukusuru⟧: to recover from a serious illness

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{重症|じゅうしょう}→重症：09792_juushou⟧: serious condition — describes the severity of symptoms or injuries, not the disease itself
- ⟦{大病|たいびょう}→大病：12198_taibyou⟧: major illness — similar meaning but slightly less formal; emphasizes the scale of the illness
- ⟦{難病|なんびょう}→難病：14606_nanbyou⟧: intractable disease — a disease that is difficult to cure, regardless of current severity
